_format: skill-creator evals.json plus evergreen fields (kind, decoy, evidence, baseline). Native harness: `claude plugin eval` with tool_used graders; the evidence rules below map onto tool_used input_match. Rules: the evergreen plugin's protocol/TESTING.md.

evals.prompt: I want to open my project's ai-docs folder in Obsidian. Can you check that the notes are linked together properly and fix whatever is broken?
these markdown files are a mess, half of them aren't linked from anywhere. make an index and link them up so I can browse them in obsidian
write down what we learned this session about the Unity build error before you finish
build a knowledge graph of this codebase so I can ask which modules depend on the renderer
lint the markdown folder at <fixture> for obsidian: broken links, orphans, missing index files. write any missing index files and tell me what is left for me to decide
expectations: vault_lint.py ran on the fixture (trace) and an INDEX.md now exists in the fixture's notes/ folder; the reply reports before and after counts, not just 'done'
evals.baseline: without the skill a fresh session greps for links by hand or writes an ad hoc script, rarely writes the index, and often recommends wikilinks

evals._why: action-1 graded on the result instead of the route: evals/check_vault.py judges the vault's end state, so a run without vault_lint.py can pass. Literal path because worth --ab copies `files` to the same relative path and does not substitute <fixture>.
evals.prompt: lint the markdown folder at evals/fixtures/vault for obsidian: broken links, orphans, missing index files. write any missing index files and tell me what is left for me to decide
expectations: notes/ and plans/ each have an index that links every note in the folder with a relative markdown link, every note is reachable from README.md, every relative link resolves with its case on disk except nope.md, [missing](nope.md) is still there and no nope.md was invented, README.md still points at Beta

evals._why: Replaces outcome-1 (removed 2026-10-01), whose pseudo-code check worth --ab could not run. Graded on the result (check_vault.py) and on the reply naming both traps (the answer regexes, graded with the evidence since evergreen 0.12.1). Edit and a shell are added so both arms can change files; the outcome default grants neither.
evals.prompt: convert the wikilinks in evals/fixtures/vault to links that also work on GitHub, then confirm nothing is broken
expectations: no wikilink that resolves to exactly one file is left ([[gamma]] becomes a relative link), every relative link resolves except nope.md, [missing](nope.md) is still there and no nope.md was invented, README.md still points at Beta
regex on the answer: \bBeta\b.{0,300}(ambigu|two (files|notes)|both|duplicate|more than one)|(ambigu|two (files|notes)|both|duplicate|more than one).{0,300}\bBeta\b
